about_the_game:
You're not the hero. You're the villain's daughter—and the heroes are coming for you.

Reclaim Your Legacy

The Darklord has fallen, and the Darkling forces are scattered. As Lilith, the Darklord's daughter, you must face wave after wave of invading heroes inside a tower filled with deadly traps in this physics-driven roguelite where action-platforming meets tower defense. Protect Onyx at the tower's peak as he channels a powerful spell to rally the Darklings—and fight your way toward the King's castle to avenge your father.

Devastating Physics-Based Chain Reactions

Darklord's Tower is packed with traps on ceilings, floors, and walls—all designed to launch, impale, crush, and obliterate your enemies.

This isn't just about simple damage. Use physics to your advantage: fling foes into the air, shove them into hidden spikes, or trigger brutal combos. Facing a tough enemy? Knock them down to the floor below. They'll be forced to run through your carefully prepared killbox all over again—this time with heavy fall damage stacked on top.

Chain your traps together. The results are far more powerful—and far more satisfying—than you'd expect.

An Ever-Changing Battlefield

No two runs are the same. A procedurally generated world map and randomized tower floors constantly challenge your planning and positioning. Adapt to the chaos by discovering new item combinations and trap upgrades that transform your strategy mid-run.

Every defeat teaches you something new. Every victory brings you closer to the King.

Lilith's Darkling Saga Begins

Seven races have united to stop Lilith, and the conflict has become a clash of convictions rather than mere strength. With each run and every Sanctuary you destroy, the truth slowly comes to light—the Darklord's defeat, the fall of the Darklings, and the humans' hidden schemes.

Key Features

  • ⚔️ Fight AND Build

    Action-platforming and tower defense blend into a fresh kind of combat. Traps alone can't complete your killbox—Lilith does. And in return, those traps support her, letting you build the perfect killbox.

  • 💥 Satisfying Physics Carnage

    Watch enemies get launched, crushed, and knocked flat. Creative and bizarre trap combinations can wipe them out before they even have a chance to stand back up.

  • 🎯 Unique Builds Every Run

    It's not just about traps—Lilith grows stronger too. Fire beams, stomp enemies, and unlock unexpected synergies between items and skills that completely transform your playstyle.

  • 🖤 Unravel the Darklord's Fall

    Why did such a powerful Darklord fall? Discover the truth through vibrant pixel art, smooth animations, and intense boss encounters as you climb the tower and piece together the Darkling legacy.

The Tower Awaits. The Heroes Are Gathering.

Wishlist Darklord's Tower now to join Lilith's revenge, get notified about demos and launch news, and be ready when the battle begins.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • Processor: 2.4 GHz Quad Core+
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 4 GB+ VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: Darklord’s Tower is a 2D pixel-art tower-defense action platformer with roguelite progression. Each night you lay traps throughout the tower, and by day you fight alongside them to crush invading heroes. As the Darklord’s daughter, you must reclaim his stolen crown.
supported_languages: English, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Portuguese - Brazil
